Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

Stripe is beloved by developers for the simplicity of our APIs, the thoroughness of our documentation, and our focus on developer experience. The Technical Solutions Engineering (TSE) team supports developers who use Stripe and champions developer experience as central to our users’ overall experience. TSE interacts directly with developers more than any other team at Stripe, so your role will have a significant impact on what Stripe is known for and values most. When we do our job well, developers all over the world can launch and grow their businesses on Stripe, whether they’re integrating payments for the first time or building complex financial systems.

What you’ll do

Technical Solutions Engineers understand the fundamentals of programming incredibly well and eagerly familiarize themselves with others’ code. You’ll explain technical concepts about Stripe’s products, build and debug integrations with developers, and produce and improve guides that help our users solve problems and succeed with Stripe. You’ll interact with developers of all skill levels through a variety of channels.

Early on, current team members will devote time to teaching you and helping you build comfort and expertise with Stripe, its services, and how we interact with users. Later, we’d love for you to take on this role with others on the team and across Stripe, as teaching is a great way to learn and reinforce what you know.

If you enjoy working with all kinds of code, researching quickly, writing clearly, and helping others build products their businesses depend on, we want to hear from you!

Responsibilities

  • Communicate with external developers and help them build applications using Stripe’s infrastructure across programming languages and frameworks, including Java, Python, Ruby, PHP, Go, Node.js, .NET, React, React Native, Swift, Objective-C, Kotlin, and Java for Android
  • Unblock external developers facing complex integration challenges through email, ticketing software, issue trackers, developer community platforms, and real-time chat
  • Develop and maintain internal and external documentation, examples, integration demos, and code snippets that demonstrate usage patterns for Stripe’s infrastructure
  • Identify points of friction developers encounter and collaborate with engineering teams to improve Stripe products, including participating in their regular planning sessions, design reviews, and development meetings
  • Develop and maintain internal support tools for TSE and Stripe Support more broadly, such as a retrieval-augmented generation copilot powered by a large language model or a tool that explains invoices
  • Act as a developer advocate and educational resource within Stripe by regularly creating training for non-developers and responding to product integration questions in real time

Who you are

We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

  • At least 4 years of full-stack software development experience, with a proven track record of building web or mobile applications that deliver high-quality user experiences
  • Direct experience explaining technical concepts and comfort explaining how Stripe works to both technical and non-technical audiences
  • Ability to write clean code in multiple programming languages and read code that may be less well structured
  • Ability to support users during working hours in your region. This may occasionally include weekend coverage to monitor and support critical infrastructure, given the team’s knowledge of Stripe’s products and active integrations. The team is largely remote, and we support working arrangements that accommodate family care and other needs.

Preferred qualifications

  • Enjoyment of writing clearly and quickly
  • General software engineering skills, with an understanding that new languages and frameworks can be learned when the underlying concepts are understood
  • Experience teaching or coaching developers
  • Excellent spoken and written English, with the ability to confidently explain technical concepts, troubleshoot issues, and answer customer questions in Mandarin over video calls.
  • Comfort working with substantial autonomy and limited supervision
  • A degree in computer science, software engineering, computer engineering, or a related analytical field of study
descriptions.job-1dg522e:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

Product Sales is a team of deep functional and technical specialists who both lead and advise on deals for the most strategically important products in Stripe’s portfolio. Stripe is investing in building out its Fraud & Risk  Product Sales team and as an Account Executive you will be a critical part of the team driving the growth of this product.

What you’ll do

As an Account Executive, Product focusing on Fraud & Risk you will use your sales and product expertise to help drive product market fit & growth of Stripe’s risk and fraud fighting products and solutions. You will collaborate with product, engineering and marketing teams to develop deep product and industry knowledge and drive strategic deals. You will be instrumental in leading in depth product discussions with existing and prospect users globally – and building and executing against our go to market strategy.

You are an adept salesperson, capable of engaging in business-level and technical conversations at multiple levels of the organization, including CEOs, CTOs, and Chief Risk Officers. You are used to building value in competitive situations and enjoy working on products that require deep product understanding. You’re as comfortable working with clients as with internal stakeholders (including executives). You’re excited to become an expert and to share your knowledge. You’re an organized self-starter, an excellent communicator who is highly analytical and has a track record for improving the processes and organizations around you.

Responsibilities

  • Drive new business and revenue growth by selling Radar, Identity, Dispute Prevention and more to a variety of businesses 
  • Lead complex new and expansion deals related to Stripe’s Fraud & Risk product offerings, capabilities, and tailored solutions
  • Deeply understand the sales process and what competitors offer in terms of fraud fighting capabilities, with a strong emphasis to overcoming competition to win all deals
  • Synthesize and relay customer feedback and findings to inform Stripe’s product roadmap
  • Engage with Product, Marketing and Account teams to help amplify our growth trajectory globally

Who you are

We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Requirements

  • 10+ years of customer facing experience at a leading technology or payments company and a track record of top performance, working specifically on enterprise or strategic accounts in Southeast Asia and China markets
  • High professional fluency in Mandarin and English, as the role involves working with users within the Greater China region
  • Display a deep passion for fraud prevention and develop deep expertise 
  • A proven ability to build strong collaborative working relationships with business partners internally and externally
  • The ability to deal effectively with ambiguity and thrive in an unstructured, fast-moving environment
  • Experience building trusted advisor relationships with senior business leaders
  • Self-starter capable of operating independently to drive meaningful business results
  • Ability to understand complex technical requirements and craft solutions across multiple stakeholders
  • Proven experience to lead complex negotiations involving bespoke commercial agreements

Preferred Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience specifically selling fraud solutions for payments to enterprise customers

Job Title: Regional Sales Director, Private Sector (Financial Services), NEMEA

Location: London, United Kingdom

The Chainalysis Private Sector team helps financial services organizations understand blockchain activity, manage financial crime risk, and adopt digital assets with confidence. Across NEMEA, we work with banks, fintechs, payments businesses, and digital asset companies to address compliance, fraud, and investigation needs. Our sales team partners with specialists across the business to connect customer priorities with the right blockchain intelligence solutions.

As Regional Sales Director, you lead and develop the Private Sector Financial Services sales team across NEMEA from London. You own the regional sales strategy and revenue performance, combining disciplined execution with hands-on support for complex enterprise deals. You build senior customer relationships and help the team translate financial crime challenges and digital asset opportunities into clear business value. You create an accountable, collaborative environment where sales executives develop their skills and consistently deliver results.

In this role, you'll:

  • Lead, coach, and develop a team of sales executives to meet and exceed individual and regional revenue targets.

  • Define and execute the NEMEA financial services sales strategy, prioritizing markets, customer segments, and accounts based on opportunity and customer needs.

  • Own regional bookings and annual recurring revenue targets, balancing new customer acquisition with expansion across existing accounts.

  • Build qualified pipeline through account planning, targeted prospecting, and coordinated engagement with Marketing, Sales Development, and partners.

  • Guide complex enterprise sales cycles from discovery through negotiation and close, engaging compliance, fraud, risk, investigations, technology, procurement, and executive stakeholders.

  • Build relationships with senior financial services decision-makers and help customers connect blockchain intelligence to their business objectives.

  • Maintain accurate forecasts and Salesforce records, using pipeline reviews and sales activity data to identify risks and coach the team.

  • Partner with Solutions Engineering, Product, Customer Success, and other specialists to develop customer solutions, support adoption, and identify expansion opportunities.

  • Stay current on digital asset adoption, financial crime trends, and relevant UK and European regulatory developments to inform account strategies and customer conversations.

  • Recruit and onboard sales executives, establish clear expectations, and build a collaborative team culture across the region.


We're looking for candidates who have:

  • 7+ years of enterprise B2B SaaS sales experience, including at least 3 years leading and developing quota-carrying sales teams.

  • A record of meeting or exceeding multimillion annual recurring revenue targets in complex, consultative sales environments.

  • Experience selling technology or data solutions to financial services organizations, including banks, fintechs, or payments businesses.

  • Experience engaging compliance, financial crime, fraud, risk, or investigations teams and translating their needs into a business case.

  • Experience leading sales across multiple markets, with an understanding of the UK and broader NEMEA financial services landscape.

  • Demonstrated ability to coach sales executives, recruit talent, and manage performance against clear goals.

  • Strong executive communication and negotiation skills, with experience managing complex procurement processes and multiple decision-makers.

  • Proficiency in Salesforce and sales analytics, with a disciplined approach to pipeline management, forecasting, and account planning.


Nice to have experience:

  • Experience selling blockchain intelligence, financial crime analytics, fraud prevention, or RegTech solutions.

  • Knowledge of digital assets, stablecoins, and blockchain use cases in banking and payments.

  • Familiarity with UK digital asset regulation, EU MiCA requirements, AML/KYC obligations, and FATF guidance.

  • An established network of financial services relationships across EMEA, additional regional language skills, or experience developing partner-led opportunities.

 
 

About Chainalysis

Blockchain technology is powering a growing wave of innovation. Businesses and governments around the world are using blockchains to make banking more efficient, connect with their customers, and investigate criminal cases. As adoption of blockchain technology grows, more and more organizations seek access to all this ecosystem has to offer. That’s where Chainalysis comes in. We provide complete knowledge of what’s happening on blockchains through our data, services, and solutions. With Chainalysis, organizations can navigate blockchains safely and with confidence.

You belong here.

At Chainalysis, we believe that diversity of experience and thought makes us stronger. With both customers and employees around the world, we are committed to ensuring our team reflects the unique communities around us. Some of the ways we’re ensuring we keep learning are an internal Diversity Committee, Days of Reflection throughout the year including International Women’s Day, Harvey Milk Day, World Humanitarian Day, and UN International Migrants Day, and a commitment to continue revisiting and reevaluating our diversity culture.

We encourage applicants across any race, ethnicity, gender/gender expression, age, spirituality, ability, experience and more. Additionally, if you need any accommodations to make our interview process more accessible to you due to a disability, don't hesitate to let us know. You can learn more here. We can’t wait to meet you.

AI at Chainalysis
AI is not a feature at Chainalysis - it is a new way of working. One that turns instructions into work done, and helps us move faster than the threats we're built to counter, and we expect our employees to take ownership of the output and ensure quality. As the world's most trusted blockchain analytics platform, Chainalysis sits at a rare intersection of proprietary data, regulatory relationships and crypto expertise that makes it uniquely placed to shape and lead the next era of AI-driven intelligence - and we expect everyone here, regardless of role, to be an active part of it.

AI fluency is tied directly to how we measure performance and how we plan to win. There is no substitute for your own curiosity. We provide the tools, workflows, and space to experiment - but the expectation is that you develop these capabilities yourself, bring ideas, and collaborate across teams to reinvent the way work gets done. We are not using AI to do less. We are using it to do what was never possible before.

About Chainalysis

Chainalysis is the blockchain data platform, making it easy to connect the movement of digital assets to real-world services. Powered by deep blockchain data and AI, organizations can investigate illicit activity, manage risk exposure, and develop innovative market solutions built on the industry's most trusted blockchain intelligence. Our mission is to build trust in blockchains, blending safety and security with an unwavering commitment to growth and innovation.

You belong here. 

At Chainalysis, we believe that diversity of experience and thought makes us stronger. With both customers and employees around the world, we are committed to ensuring our team reflects the unique communities around us. We’re ensuring we keep learning by committing to continually revisit and reevaluate our diversity culture.

We encourage applicants across any race, ethnicity, gender/gender expression, age, spirituality, ability, experience and more. If you need any accommodations to make our interview process more accessible to you due to a disability, don't hesitate to let us know. You can learn more here. We can’t wait to meet you.

Ready to do the most impactful work of your career? At Coinbase, we are uncompromising on our mission to increase economic freedom. The bar is high, the environment is intense, and we like it that way. This isn't a place for complacency, it’s a place to be pushed past your perceived limits. If you're ready to build the future of finance alongside people who refuse to settle for "good enough," you belong here. Coinbase is a remote-first, but not remote-only company. Expect to get together quarterly for intense in-person working sessions called “surges.” Learn more about working at Coinbase.

The ML & Discovery team in Consumer Growth builds the machine learning systems that help millions of customers discover what to trade and engage with next across crypto, equities, derivatives, and prediction markets. Our models and platforms power personalized feed and asset ranking, intelligent notification orchestration, and LLM-driven market insights across the Coinbase app. As a Senior Machine Learning Engineer (L5) you will own end-to-end initiatives across the ML lifecycle, from problem formulation, feature engineering, and modeling to production serving and online A/B experimentation. Partnering closely with Product, Data Science, and Engineering in a high-velocity, data-driven environment, you will shape our team's roadmap, raise our engineering quality bar, and use AI-native workflows to deliver measurable business impact.

What you’ll do: 

  • Own end-to-end machine learning initiatives from problem formulation and offline evaluation to production deployment and online A/B testing, driving measurable lifts in user engagement, retention, and trading activity.
  • Build and iterate on multi-stage recommendation, retrieval, and contextual bandit models that serve personalized experiences to millions of users across crypto, equities, derivatives, and prediction markets.
  • Design intelligent notification orchestration, candidate ranking, and targeting systems that match users with timely, high-value alerts while avoiding fatigue and improving user experience.
  • Develop production LLM pipelines, grounding workflows, and automated evaluation loops that generate accurate, real-time market insights and personalized financial content.
  • Architect resilient, low-latency model serving services and real-time feature pipelines, eliminating technical debt, leading incident response, and raising our operational reliability bar.
  • Partner with Product, Data Science, and Engineering to shape the team roadmap, mentor L3-L4 engineers, and build AI-native workflows and automation that multiply team velocity.

Required Skills and Experience:

  • 5+ years of experience in machine learning engineering and software development, with a track record of shipping production ML systems that move customer and business metrics.
  • Proven track record in one or more relevant domains: recommendation systems, multi-stage ranking and retrieval, contextual bandits, notification targeting, or production LLM applications.
  • Strong software engineering and data skills in a backend language like Python or Go, with hands-on proficiency in modern ML and data stacks (such as PyTorch, GBDTs, Spark/Databricks, Ray, Kafka, and/or Tecton).
  • Deep practical knowledge of offline model evaluation, training-serving skew mitigation, and design/interpretation of online A/B experiments tied to business metrics.
  • Demonstrated ability to drive complex projects end-to-end, make pragmatic architectural trade-offs, and mentor junior engineers.
  • Utilizes generative AI responsibly, maintaining human oversight to deliver business-ready outputs and drive measurable improvements in workflow efficiency, cost, and quality.

descriptions.job-1xel16e:
Hut 8 brings exceptional people together to solve the world’s most consequential problems at the intersection of energy and technology. Today, that means building infrastructure for AI at a pace and scale without precedent. Tomorrow, it could mean powering a new era of innovation through robotics, advanced manufacturing, or an industry that does not yet exist. Whatever the technology demands, our ambition holds: to build the defining physical infrastructure company of our generation.

We look for thinkers and builders with the rigor, humility, and ownership to solve problems at this scale. They start from zero and choose truth over tradition. They back the best idea, whatever its source. They bet on themselves and embrace the hard truths that force them to grow. Our commitment is to keep the path from idea to execution short, trust them with critical decisions and the work that follows, and surround them with colleagues whose curiosity extends beyond their expertise.

ABOUT THE ROLE

The Legal Counsel (Real Estate & Development) role will provide legal support across the company’s Data Center and Energy Infrastructure portfolio. This is a hands-on, high-volume role focused on the front end of the development lifecycle: site control, diligence, and deal execution. You will work directly with our development, operations, asset management, energy origination and strategic financing teams, serving as their primary legal counterpart. 

Key Responsibilities

  • Draft, review, and negotiate letters of intent, land options, purchase agreements, easements, access agreements, tax abatement agreements, shared facilities agreements, construction contracts, long lead equipment procurement agreements, costs in aid of construction agreements, interconnection agreements and other ancillary development documents.
  • Provide legal support on project finance and real estate loan transactions, including loan documents, infrastructure agreements, power-related agreements, and leases with data center end users.
  • Manage the documentation lifecycle for the company’s data center development and energy infrastructure projects, ensuring all agreements are executed with precision and align with the company’s strategic objectives.
  • Act as the primary legal liaison for the development, operations, asset management, energy origination and strategic financing teams.
  • Coordinate with outside counsel, title agents, surveyors, and environmental consultants to ensure that every site is thoroughly vetted and prepared for commercialization. 
  • Conduct and coordinate legal due diligence, including review of title commitments, ALTA surveys, environmental reports, and zoning analyses. 

ABOUT YOU

  • You have a rigorous, detail-oriented approach to reviewing title, survey, environmental, and zoning reports for large-scale infrastructure or energy projects.
  • You excel at managing high-volume document workflows, tracking critical deadlines, and maintaining strict version control across multiple simultaneous site acquisitions.
  • You are a strategic thinker with a practical, business-oriented approach to legal issues.
  • You are comfortable working directly with non-legal teams and can translate complex legal issues into clear guidance that helps inform commercial decisions. 
  • You thrive in fast-paced, deal-intensive environments and take ownership of your workstreams from first draft through closing. 

Qualifications

  • Active license to practice law in at least one U.S. State and a member in good standing of one U.S. Bar.
  • 3+ years of experience in commercial real estate, infrastructure, or energy law, with a focus on land acquisition, site control, and transactional diligence. 
  • Proven track record of drafting and negotiating front-end real estate documents: LOIs, purchase options, purchase and sale agreements, easements, and access agreements.
  • Experience coordinating with title companies, surveyors, and environmental consultants on large-scale land or infrastructure transactions.
  • Familiarity with project finance or real estate loan transactions is a plus.
  • Experience in data center, energy, or digital infrastructure is a plus but not required. 

ABOUT THE WORK ENVIRONMENT

This role is in office at our corporate headquarters in the Brickell area of Miami, Florida. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

descriptions.job-1sbz9di:
About Us

DriveWealth is on a mission to make investing easier. We believe that everyone should have the ability to control their financial future, and that access to financial markets should not be limited by geography, wealth, or legacy systems. We are a global B2B financial technology organization dedicated to democratizing access to financial independence around the world. Our mission is realized through an API-based platform, empowering our partners to offer seamless investing and trading experiences to clients worldwide, all from their mobile devices. Our technology provides partners with a modern, extensible toolkit, enabling traditional investment workflows and innovative techniques like fractional share ownership. DriveWealth has evolved into a global platform offering trading of US equities, mutual funds, ETFs, fixed income, and options.

There’s never been a better time to build a category-defining business and there has rarely been a team better positioned for this opportunity. Our culture blends the pace and agility of a fintech start-up with the impact, stability, and discipline of Wall Street. We encourage creativity and experimentation while ensuring institutional-grade execution and regulatory compliance in everything we do. Join us and help build the future of global investing!

About the Role

As a Product Marketing Analyst, you’ll help shape how our products are understood, valued, and adopted in the market. You’ll support the team by turning customer needs, market insights, and product capabilities into clear, compelling stories that connect with customers and support business growth.

In this highly collaborative role, you’ll work closely with Product, Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success to support product launches, strengthen our competitive position, and help equip customer-facing teams with the tools they need to succeed. You’ll learn from experienced marketers, contribute your own ideas, and see your work directly contribute to engagement and adoption.

What You’ll Do

  • Support product launches by coordinating timelines, tasks, and deliverables across teams
  • Contribute to product positioning and messaging by drafting and refining copy and key materials
  • Gather and summarize market and customer insights to share with the business
  • Partner with cross-functional teams and help bring the customer perspective into conversations
  • Track and report on campaign and launch performance, and recommend improvements
  • Help drive product adoption through supporting campaigns and resources
  • Create and maintain sales enablement materials such as one-pagers, battle cards, and decks
  • Conduct market and competitive research and keep competitor profiles up to date
  • Assist with content development and marketing campaigns

You Bring

  • 1-3 years of experience in marketing, product marketing, market research, or a related area
  • Clear, confident writing and presentation skills, with a knack for explaining complex topics simply
  • A curiosity about the market, including hands-on experience with research, competitor tracking, or gathering customer feedback
  • Comfort with tools like PowerPoint or Google Slides, and experience building decks, one-pagers, or other marketing content
  • A team-first attitude and a willingness to work with Product, Sales, and Customer Success
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, with the ability to juggle multiple projects and deadlines
  • Comfort working with data, such as pulling together campaign metrics or survey results to spot trends
  • A customer-first mindset and an interest in understanding what drives customer decisions

Location

This role is open to candidates in the following locations: New York City, NY - Hybrid

  • This role is expected to come into the office on a cadence set by the Hiring Manager/Team.
  • If you're not based in one of the locations listed above, this role is not a fit, and we cannot accommodate remote work outside these locations.
  • Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. DriveWealth does not sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment visa at this time.

Pay Range: $100,000 – $120,000 USD

Working at DriveWealth

We do our best work when we're in the same room. To maintain the speed our partners expect, our New York, Chicago, and Lithuania teams work in office on a hybrid schedule. We've found that being physically side-by-side is the only way to solve complex problems in real-time and stay truly accountable to the products we ship. When you're here, you're working directly with the people making the decisions.

To support that work, we provide competitive compensation, equity, and a 401(k) match. We also offer Medical insurance, Dental insurance, Vision insurance, Disability insurance, and Paid Parental Leave, along with a wellness reimbursement, a company-provided phone, and a personal development allowance. Finally, we value the time you spend away from the office with generous Paid Time Off (PTO) and observed holidays.

Work Authorization

Applicants must possess the legal right to work in the country where the position is located at the time of application. DriveWealth requires all employees to provide original documentation verifying their work authorization on or before their first day of employment.

For US-based roles: Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis without the need for current or future visa sponsorship. DriveWealth does not provide visa sponsorship or support for employment authorization, including transfers, at this time. Offers of employment are strictly contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the Company.

How We Think About AI

We leverage AI to work smarter and move faster. We seek AI-curious talent who are proactive about using emerging tools to increase signal quality, reduce friction, and improve outcomes to deliver products faster, provide better service to our partners, and to streamline processes. Your ability to leverage our internal tools and technology to drive results is as important to us as your core domain expertise.

Compensation

Pay is generally based on the level, complexity, responsibility, location, and job duties/requirements of the specific position. We then source candidates with the requisite skills, expertise, education, training, and experience.  If you are selected for an interview, please feel welcome to speak to a recruiter about our compensation philosophy and other available benefits. This role is eligible for base, bonus, equity, 401(k) match, and heavily subsidized benefits and perks.

Equal Employment Opportunity

To build technology and products that are used and loved by people and solve real-world problems, we need to build a team with many different perspectives and experiences. We are an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply. 

Agency Disclaimer

DriveWealth does not accept agency resumes. Do not forward resumes to our jobs alias, employees, or any other organization location. DriveWealth is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

descriptions.job-1khegmu:
Applying to Paxos? Our only careers site is paxos.com/careers, and we only recruit via @paxos.com email. Details below.
___

About Paxos

Today’s financial infrastructure is archaic, expensive, inefficient and risky — supporting a system that leaves out more people than it lets in. So we’re rebuilding it.

We’re on a mission to open the world’s financial system to everyone by enabling the instant movement of any asset, any time, in a trustworthy way. For over a decade, we’ve built blockchain infrastructure that tokenizes, custodies, trades and settles assets for the world's leading financial institutions, like PayPal, Venmo, Mastercard, Interactive Brokers and Charles Schwab.

About the team

The Accounting team provides in-depth guidance to the rest of the organization on financial results, delivering insights that shape key decisions from daily operations to long-term strategy. Within Accounting, the Revenue team makes sure Paxos’s revenue is accurately billed, recognized and reported across its products and legal entities. The team solves complex accounting questions in an environment with new regulations, technologies and business models. That work supports Paxos’s mission of building a more open and inclusive financial system.

About the role

As a Senior Revenue Accountant, you’ll own key parts of the monthly revenue close, from preparing and reviewing accruals and journal entries to reconciling billing and revenue data. You’ll apply ASC 606 to new and existing customer arrangements and help document accounting conclusions. You’ll also find ways to make revenue processes more accurate, scalable and automated. You’ll work closely with Product, Sales, Treasury, Strategic Finance and Operations to understand how new deals and products affect revenue, and you’ll support audit requests. This role is critical to delivering accurate, timely revenue reporting as Paxos grows.

What you'll do

  • Prepare and review monthly revenue accruals, journal entries and supporting schedules as part of month-end close.

  • Reconcile billing, invoicing and revenue data across systems and resolve variances.

  • Support review of customer contracts and apply ASC 606 to determine the right revenue treatment.

  • Prepare revenue flux analysis and explain month-over-month changes.

  • Support external audit requests and prepare revenue-related workpapers.

  • Help maintain revenue accounting policies, process documentation and internal controls.

  • Identify manual processes and help redesign them for scale, including through automation and AI tools.

  • Partner with cross functional teams to understand new products and pricing and their accounting impact.

  • Immerse yourself in blockchain technology, stablecoins and enterprise crypto infrastructure, and in our regulation-first approach.

  • For folks with fewer than 4 years of relevant work experience, this is a hybrid role based in our New York City Midtown office, with in-office attendance required.

About you

  • 3+ years of combined experience in public accounting (audit) and/or in-house accounting, with a focus on revenue.

  • Hands-on experience applying ASC 606, including variable consideration, minimums and usage-based fees.

  • A bachelor’s degree in accounting and strong knowledge of US GAAP. A CPA or progress toward one is preferred.

  • Month-end close experience in NetSuite or another major ERP.

  • Strong Excel/Google Sheets skills, with experience building or maintaining reconciliation and accrual workbooks.

  • Experience using AI tools to improve accuracy or efficiency in accounting work.

  • Experience in fintech, financial services or a high-growth company (nice to have).

  • Excellent organizational, communication and cross-functional skills.

Important Notice for Paxos Applicants
Fraudulent accounts sometimes pose as Paxos recruiters on LinkedIn and other platforms, and fake websites sometimes impersonate our careers site. These scammers attempt to deceive applicants into paying for job opportunities or providing personal financial information.

To verify a legitimate Paxos opportunity:

  • Our only official careers site is paxos.com/careers

  • We only use @paxos.com email addresses

  • We never ask for payment or financial details to apply, interview, or work here

  • For technical roles, we do not perform a coding interview without prior screening by our engineering team

Thanks for your interest in Paxos!
descriptions.job-16tel4m:
About Ramp

Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $275B in annualized spend flows in and out of 85,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.

The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.

We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.

The median Ramp customer saves 7.5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.

If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.

About the Role

Ramp is launching payments across the EU through its Swedish payment institution. Our European operations team (Europs) onboards European businesses and keeps them trading, across Ramp's own regulated entities and our card-issuing and payments partners. We're a small team that runs on frontier AI tooling: our operators build and use their own automations so they can spend their time on judgement, not admin. We're hiring a KYB/AML Analyst in Stockholm to review and onboard business customers of our Swedish entity, work directly with those customers to get them live, and resolve onboarding requirements raised by our partners. You'll join a small Swedish team and help keep onboarding moving every day as we grow.

What You'll Do

  • Carry out first-line (1LoD) KYB reviews of business customers onboarding with Ramp's Swedish payment institution: company verification, beneficial ownership, sanctions/PEP/adverse-media screening, and risk assessment

  • Decide standard cases end to end, and escalate complex or higher-risk cases with a clear rationale

  • Handle customer communications through onboarding: clear document requests, follow-ups and status updates

  • Resolve onboarding requirements from our card-issuing and payments partners for EU customers

  • Document decisions to a standard that holds up to second-line and regulatory review

  • Keep Swedish casework moving when teammates are on leave or handling incidents

  • Spend part of your time improving how we work: playbooks, templates and AI-assisted workflows

What You Need

  • 2–4 years of KYB / AML / onboarding experience at a fintech, payment institution, EMI or bank

  • Solid grounding in business customer due diligence: company registers, UBO identification, sanctions/PEP screening, and spotting red flags

  • Fluent English, written and verbal

  • Clear, friendly written communication with customers

  • Curiosity about AI tools and how they can make casework faster and better

  • Based in, or relocating to, Stockholm, with the right to work in Sweden

Nice-to-Haves

  • Experience onboarding EU businesses across several jurisdictions

descriptions.job-13fanp2:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

Our Japan Marketing team’s mission is to engage priority audiences through impactful and relevant marketing campaigns and events, to drive growth in adoption of Stripe’s solution offerings. Japan Marketing is a sales-aligned team, partnering closely with the Japan GTM organization, including Sales, Sales Development, Solutions Architects, Partnerships, and others. Our team works across all customer segments, and at each stage of the customer lifecycle journey. As a member of the Japan team, this is a great opportunity to build and have an impact on the Japan business.

What you’ll do

You’ll be part of the Japan team, setting and executing our Japan marketing strategy while working hands-on and developing a trusted relationship with Sales to drive successful user outcomes. The Head of Japan Marketing will lead the field marketing function and deliver high-quality leads, pipeline, and revenue. You will build, lead, and grow a small team of marketing leaders and professionals, and establish how the team responsibly uses AI to sharpen customer insight, accelerate execution, and improve performance. As an early member of the team, you will have an opportunity to build the Japan marketing function at Stripe.

Responsibilities

  • Lead marketing for Japan across all customer segments, with strong coordination with Sales leadership; customer segments include enterprise, digital native, software platforms, small businesses, and startups 
  • Own key business and revenue metrics across the sales funnel (pipeline) and customer growth and retention. 
  • Develop a strong trusted relationship with the Japanese sales team, working closely with the sales leadership and sales development to jointly grow pipeline.
  • Partner with Asia Pacific demand generation and product marketing to refine our targeting and segmentation, and to identify, scope, and produce or localize compelling content, marketing assets and programs to drive demand
  • Define and execute full funnel Japan marketing plans including digital marketing, demand generation campaigns, sales prospecting programs and ABM, virtual and in-person field events, and third party tradeshows and conferences
  • Track, measure, and communicate program results, continually optimize for efficiency and scale, and seek to generate new global best practices through experimental efforts  
  • Be creative in finding new ways of advising a diverse range of personas about the value Stripe brings to businesses.
  • Set the Japan marketing team’s AI-enabled operating model, identifying high-value use cases across research, segmentation, localization, content development, campaign execution, measurement, and experimentation while maintaining strong judgment on quality, customer context, and responsible use.
  • Coach the team to adopt AI effectively, building repeatable workflows and raising the bar for strategic thinking, speed, and execution.

Who you are

We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

  • 10+ years of relevant B2B marketing experience leading a Japan marketing function across multiple customer segments including specific experience with content localisation and content marketing, event management, partnership marketing, and multi-touch campaigns to generate demand.
  • At least 5 years managing teams, with a track record of setting a clear strategy, developing talent, and leading through change
  • Proven track record of defining and executing Japan B2B marketing strategies that deliver against funnel metrics and KPIs
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills (both Japanese and English), including being able to convey complex topics with simplicity
  • Proven leadership capability and effectiveness working collaboratively and cross functionally:
    • Experience working closely with Sales teams, including joint planning and execution, driving disciplined lead follow up, and earning trust as a strategic business partner
    • Experience working as a Japanese leader partnering with global marketing teams, and leveraging central APAC capabilities and resources to lead growth in field marketing programs and events, executive programs and partner programs.
  • Experience scaling through/and or leveraging agency and contractor resources
  • Understanding and/or experience with CRM, account-based marketing, email marketing tactics, and marketing technology
  • Demonstrated AI fluency in a B2B marketing context: hands-on experience using AI to improve insight, planning, content, execution, or measurement; ability to evaluate output quality and risk; and experience helping a team adopt new tools and workflows

Preferred qualifications

  • A startup mentality with a bias to action and the ability to flex in a fast-paced industry and work environment
  • Experience marketing cloud services and/or software solutions 
  • Superb organization and project management skills and the capacity to manage multiple complex projects at once
  • Excellent analytical skills and the ability to craft actionable insights from complex data
  • Resourceful, creative and dedicated to achieving operational and creative excellence
  • Experience delivering tailored marketing content and experiences for customer segments spanning from early stage startups to the largest enterprise companies
  • Understanding of the payments, financial technology, and/or ecommerce industries and partner ecosystems
  • Demonstrated success delivering marketing programs with and through consulting and technology partners
  • High AI usage competencies.
descriptions.job-0o9369i:
Location: NYC (onsite only – not remote)

Alliance is the leading accelerator for frontier founders. Since 2020 we've backed 300+ startups building on the frontiers of fintech and crypto (such as Rain, Pump, Kamino, Jupiter and many more), now collectively valued at $17B+.

We're hiring a Head of Capital Formation to own fundraising for Alliance's venture funds end-to-end: strategy, marketing, IR, pipeline, and close.

What you'll do

  • Own the raise: Lead and execute Alliance's capital formation plan across institutional allocators (e.g., fund of funds, family offices, foundations, endowments, pension plans, wealth management platforms) and HNWIs. You source, pitch, and close.
  • Build and run the LP pipeline: Own lead sourcing, qualification, and pipeline management. Bring the right prospects to the firm’s General Partners at the right moment, and run the process through to signed commitments.
  • Be the voice of Alliance to investors: Serve as the main point of contact for prospective and existing LPs. Communicate our strategy, track record, and edge clearly. Own the deck, data room, and other core investor materials (DDQs, RFPs, LP Letters and more).
  • Turn LPs into repeat LPs: Build long-term relationships with existing and prospective allocators. Keep them close between raises and bring them back fund after fund.
  • Shape the strategy: Work with the GPs on fund positioning, sizing, timing, and the long-term investor relations plan.
  • Build the brand: Oversee development of pitch decks and marketing materials. Assist in planning and executing AGM and other LP engagement events. Build thought leadership and connections through content, conferences, and media engagements.

What we're looking for

  • Capital raising track record: 8+ years raising for venture, private equity, private credit, or hedge funds, with closed >$40m closed directly attributable to you. Raised for an emerging manager or an early fund, where you sold on conviction rather than a 20-year track record.
  • An existing allocator network: Warm relationships with fund of funds, family offices, and HNWIs. This is a must have.
  • Tech fluency: 5+ years in crypto, fintech, AI or tech. You can hold your own with allocators on Alliance’s edge and business.
  • Sales and relationship skills: Clear communicator, strong negotiator, high degree of professionalism and discretion.
  • Pipeline discipline: Can run a long sales cycle in a CRM, keep the funnel full, and automate where it makes sense.
  • Entrepreneurial and high agency: Self-driven, spots what's broken, and takes ideas through to completion.
  • Frequent travel: NYC is home base, but you'll be on the road often, including SF and internationally.

Why NOT join us

  • Not willing to get hands dirty: doesn't matter how important you were in past organizations; at Alliance we're all builders, not managers (even though many of us were managers in past lives). There's no IR team under you.
  • Prioritizing work/life balance: this role demands focus, hunger, and a career-defining level of commitment. You must be locked in.
  • Low agency: if you need someone else to set your priorities or keep you on track, you will fail.
  • You can't relocate to NYC. This is non-negotiable: our founders are here, our brand is strongest here, and so are we. You'll travel to SF often, but you'll live in New York.

Why join us

  • Competitive salary ($175,000 - $250,000) plus fund carry.
  • Work with the most ambitious founders in crypto, fintech and AI. Learn firsthand from hundreds of startups succeeding or failing.
  • Join a small, high-trust, high-performance team with outsized impact. We're ex-Meta, WhatsApp, Coinbase, YC, and have collectively founded multiple venture-backed startups.
  • We're backed by S-tier investors including Founders Fund, Initialized Capital, Multicoin, and Dragonfly, along with angels such as Balaji Srinivasan (ex-Coinbase CTO), Kevin Weil (CPO at OpenAI), Kevin Lin (Twitch co-founder), and Jeremy Allaire (Circle CEO) among many others.
  • Alliance startups are reinventing industries—from energy markets to payments and new media—and improving the lives of everyday people. You'll have a front-row seat as they change the world and your work decides how much capital the next generation of Alliance founders gets to build with.

Founded to transform retail finance, Ajaib Group is an Indonesian fintech unicorn breaking barriers to financial access. Having recently secured a $270M Series C—the single largest funding round in Southeast Asia over the past four years—we are backed by premier global investors including Y Combinator, Ribbit Capital, SoftBank, and SBI Holdings.  

To build world-class products, we assemble world-class talent. Supported by our fully remote work arrangement, our team spans Eastern Europe, the Middle East, India, and Southeast Asia, allowing you to work with brilliant engineers and builders from around the globe from wherever you are.
